text: You're a courier. It's your last delivery. And the apartment door just locked behind you.
KOMMUNALKA. You have a flashlight, the residents have stories, and you have to decide who is lying to you.
It's point and click, which in horror means you can't run. You just pick where to look.
The demo is in English and Russian, and all five of its reviews are positive.
Worth a dip if you like your horror slow and dark.
That's Demo Dip. A new Steam demo, every day.
